# Monk (`classes:monk`)
**Hit Die:** d8 | **Saving Throws:** [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md)
**Primary Ability:** [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md), [WIS](../ability-scores/wis.md)
**Subclasses:** [Warrior of the Open Hand](../subclasses/warrior-of-the-open-hand.md)
**Proficiencies:** [Simple Weapons](../proficiencies/simple-weapons.md), [Scimitars](../proficiencies/scimitars.md), [Shortswords](../proficiencies/shortswords.md), [Hand crossbows](../proficiencies/hand-crossbows.md), [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md), [Saving Throw: STR](../proficiencies/saving-throw-str.md)

## Starting Equipment
- (a) Spear, 5 Daggers, Artisan’s Tools or Musical Instrument chosen for the tool proficiency above, Explorer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (b) 50 GP ([Spear](../equipment/spear.md), [Dagger](../equipment/dagger.md), [Artisan's Tools](../equipment-categories/artisans-tools.md), [Musical Instruments](../equipment-categories/musical-instruments.md), [Explorer's Pack](../equipment/explorers-pack.md))
